meta.title: Too many attachments on a stage are refused
gaps: The available library case submits a proposal with too many attachments and expects code 472, not the requested stage attachment error code 489.
warnings: error code 489 is not in en-IN.yml (or the backend checkout is missing) — the message cannot be checked

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error.
